Can't Wear Dentures?

Fixed Teeth Without The Palate

Gag reflex? Sore gums? Hate the plastic? Get secure fixed teeth on implants – no palate coverage, no problems.

Free 15-Min Chat1-Hour Consultation — £80Call 020 71833573

✓ No Plastic Palate · ✓ Taste Your Food Again · ✓ Fixed & Secure

For many patients, the physical sensation of a removable denture is unbearable. The bulky plastic covering the roof of the mouth can trigger a strong gag reflex, making it impossible to keep the teeth in for more than a few minutes.

Others struggle with the sensory deprivation, unable to taste food properly or feel the texture of what they are eating. This "mouthful of plastic" feeling can lead to anxiety and avoidance of social eating.

At Dental Implants London, implant-supported solutions may remove the need for palatal coverage, which can help improve taste sensation, comfort, and confidence for many patients.

Why Dentures Fail You

Severe Gag Reflex

Upper dentures extend back towards the soft palate, triggering the body's natural rejection mechanism (retching) in sensitive individuals.

Loss of Taste

Covering the palate may affect taste and temperature perception for some individuals.

Bulk & Discomfort

The sheer volume of material needed for suction can feel overwhelming, affecting speech and creating a feeling of fullness.

Psychological Barrier

The daily reminder of taking teeth "out" can be distressing. Fixed teeth become part of you; dentures remain a foreign object.

The Alternative

Go Palate-Free

By using dental implants, we can support a full arch of teeth without relying on suction from the roof of your mouth.

All-on-4 (Fixed)

A slim, horseshoe-shaped bridge screwed into implants. It does not touch your soft palate at all. Designed to reduce gagging and improve comfort.

Implant-Retained (Removable)

Even if you choose a removable option, implants allow us to cut away the palate section of the denture, significantly reducing bulk and gag reflex issues.

Breathe Easier

Implant-supported options may help restore a more natural feeling, improve taste sensation, and reduce discomfort associated with traditional dentures.
